en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard view of a riverside promenade in a European spa town. Multi‑story historic buildings line both sides of a narrow river or canal with tree‑lined walkways and small bridges crossing the water. Early 20th‑century cars and pedestrians move along the main street. The caption at the bottom identifies the scene as the spa town of Karlsbad, showing the Kurhaus, Mühlbrunn colonnade area, and Hotel Imperial.
